name: Sevelamer
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Hyperphosphatemia in CKD on dialysis (adults, not on a binder)
usual_adult_dose.dose: Serum phosphorus >5.5 to <7.5 mg/dL: 0.8 g three times daily with meals; ≥7.5 mg/dL: 1.6 g three times daily; titrate by 0.8 g per meal every 2 weeks

key_interactions.action: Take ciprofloxacin at least 2 hours before or 6 hours after sevelamer.
Take mycophenolate at least 2 hours before sevelamer.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Cyclosporine, tacrolimus, levothyroxine and other narrow-range oral drugs
key_interactions.action: Separate dosing times; monitor levels or clinical response.

serious: Dysphagia, bowel obstruction, perforation and other serious gastrointestinal events
Lower vitamin D, E, K (clotting factors) and folic acid levels
Peritonitis in peritoneal dialysis patients (8% in one 12-week study)

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to sevelamer carbonate, sevelamer hydrochloride or excipients
monitoring: Vitamin D, E, K and folate status; clotting if on anticoagulants

sources.citation: Genzyme Corporation. (2025). Renvela (sevelamer carbonate) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA022318, set ID e6328460-a57b-450b-a48c-6dcd4b476360, version effective November 25, 2025]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.

draft_notes: PD peritonitis figure is from the sevelamer hydrochloride PD study described in the label.
